I bet you haven’t even seen{CLEAR}all of Violet City yet.{SCROLL}Violet City is one of the few cities in{NEWLINE}Johto that still keep their ancient{CLEAR}style.{SCROLL}For tourists, Sprout Tower on the{NEWLINE}north side of the city is an absolute{CLEAR}must-see.

strings.en: Sudowoodo: Suuu-do!{SCROLL}The odd tree shed its disguise.{NEWLINE}It was a Sudowoodo all along!

strings.en: Crystal: So it was a Sudowoodo dressed{NEWLINE}up as a tree! No wonder it reacted so{CLEAR}strongly to water.

strings.zh: 胡说树『Suuu——do！

strings.zh: 哇！路打通了！{NEWLINE}这下终于能去缘朱市了。

strings.zh: 水晶『前辈,现在道路已经打通,{NEWLINE}我要去下一个城市收集图鉴啦。

strings.zh: 阿金『偶像,前边有棵奇怪的树{NEWLINE}把路给挡住了,{CLEAR}我用居合斩砍它完全无效。{CLEAR}学习委员说她在满金市的花店{CLEAR}问到的解决办法是给树浇水。{SCROLL}阿金『居合斩都砍不动的树,{NEWLINE}浇水就能把它移开吗？{CLEAR}我觉得学习委员是在扯淡。
strings.en: Gold: Idol, there’s an odd tree{NEWLINE}up ahead blocking the road.{CLEAR}I hit it with Cut and nothing happened.{SCROLL}Class Rep says the flower shop in{NEWLINE}Goldenrod told her to water it.{SCROLL}Gold: If even Cut can’t touch that{NEWLINE}tree, how’s watering it gonna move it?{CLEAR}I think Class Rep’s talking crap.

strings.zh: 因为有奇怪的树挡路,{NEWLINE}从这里既去不了桔梗市,{CLEAR}也去不了缘朱市。

strings.zh: 莉莉啊,叔叔我可是{NEWLINE}非常会抓精灵的高手哦。{CLEAR}漩涡岛你知道吧？{CLEAR}叔叔曾经在那里差点抓到过洛奇亚呢！

strings.zh: 哇！是胡说树！

strings.zh: 叔叔你好厉害！{NEWLINE}原来你收服精灵{CLEAR}都是直接把它们叫过来,{CLEAR}不用扔球的呀！

strings.zh: 啊啊,哈哈。那是当然的啦,{NEWLINE}因为叔叔是抓精灵的高手嘛。

strings.zh: 我们家莉莉想让我抓一只胡说树给她。{NEWLINE}但其实我……不太方便抓精灵。{CLEAR}我看这只胡说树非常喜欢{CLEAR}你身上那个香炉。{CLEAR}不如你把香炉卖给我怎么样？{CLEAR}这样我就能把胡说树留在这里了。{CLEAR}拜托了,请一定要帮帮我。{SCROLL}要把岩石香炉卖给他吗？

But the truth is, I...{CLEAR}I’m not really in a position to{CLEAR}catch Pokémon.{SCROLL}This Sudowoodo seems to{NEWLINE}love that incense of yours.{CLEAR}Why don’t you sell it to me?{CLEAR}Then I could keep Sudowoodo here.{SCROLL}Please, I’m begging you. Help me out.{SCROLL}Sell him the Rock Incense?

strings.en: My uncle is a really amazing{NEWLINE}Pokémon catcher!{SCROLL}He’s won the National Park Bug-Catching{NEWLINE}Contest more times than anyone,{CLEAR}and he once caught every kind of{CLEAR}Pokémon in the Safari Zone in Fuchsia{CLEAR}City, in Kanto!

strings.zh: 听说36号路那棵奇怪的树{NEWLINE}其实是胡说树假扮的。{CLEAR}精灵居然会假扮成树,{CLEAR}真的是好有意思啊。
strings.en: I heard that odd tree on Route 36{NEWLINE}was really a Sudowoodo in disguise.{CLEAR}A Pokémon pretending to be a tree!{CLEAR}That’s so interesting.

strings.zh: 我的叔叔不用精灵球,{NEWLINE}就能把胡说树收服。{CLEAR}真的是太厉害了！
strings.en: My uncle caught Sudowoodo without even{NEWLINE}using a Poké Ball. He’s so amazing!

strings.zh: 谢谢你啊,这样总算能够维持{NEWLINE}我在莉莉心中的形象了。
strings.en: Thank you. Now I can keep up my image{NEWLINE}in Lily’s eyes.
